name: eternities-mnemosyne
intent: Preserve and recover the smallest source-grounded state required for reliable continuity, context economy, and durable memory.
successCondition: The selected route produces a scope-bound, freshness-aware, provenance-linked result that preserves unresolved conflict and terminates without replaying unnecessary history.
inputs: available checkpoints, history, sources, or retrieval results
outputs: explicit next action and unresolved state
operations: separate active durable evidence and archive layers
positiveTriggers: recover consequential work across a session boundary
compress active context without losing executable state
design a durable agent memory system
audit memory retrieval freshness coverage or leakage
negativeTriggers: routine turn or ordinary status check
exact installed boundary or debugging workflow
failureModes: sources conflict without an authority rule
retrieval coverage or freshness is unknown
compression would discard an unresolved failure or authority limit
terminationConditions: task or memory identity and scope are explicit
consequential claims retain provenance and freshness state
conflicts unknowns and authority limits remain visible
the result fits the stated context budget
the next consumer can proceed without replaying the raw archive
